What we deliver

A single manifest, two disciplines

Every capability below is delivered by Farous directly — no re-selling scope through third parties.

ServiceScopeSector
Marine construction Jetties, quays, breakwaters and coastal reinforcement built to withstand Red Sea marine conditions. Marine
Dredging & marine support Coordination of dredging works, marine access and waterside logistics for port and resort clients. Marine
General contracting Civil works and building construction for residential, commercial and hospitality developments. Land
Fit-out & finishing Interior and exterior finishing packages delivered to a fixed scope and schedule. Land
Supply & procurement Sourcing and delivery of construction materials and equipment for land and marine sites alike. Cross-sector
Maintenance & facility support Ongoing upkeep contracts covering structures, marine assets and site facilities. Cross-sector

Scopes are combined or delivered independently, depending on the project brief.

Why Farous

One contractor, no handoffs

Clients bring us land-side and marine scope precisely because it doesn't need to be split between vendors.

Single point of accountability

One contract and one project team, even when land and marine works run side by side.

Coastal expertise

Marine works built for Red Sea conditions — salinity, tides and access included in every plan.

Direct supply chain

Materials and equipment sourced and delivered by Farous, not re-billed through intermediaries.

Schedule discipline
